pumac-2025-finals-a-02.prompt: ""Prove that there exists a constant $c>0$ such that for any set of integers $a_1>\cdots>a_n$ there exist indices $1\le i<j\le n$ such that $a_i-a_j$ has $\ge2^{c\log n/\log\log n}$ divisors.
pumac-2025-finals-a-02.answer: Pigeonhole modulo a number $m<n$ with many divisors (the largest primorial below $n$), so $\tau(a_i-a_j)\ge\tau(m)=2^r$ with $r\gg\log n/\log\log n$ by Chebyshev's estimates.

pumac-2025-finals-a-03.prompt: ""Let $ABC$ be an acute scalene triangle with orthocenter $H$, circumcenter $O$ and circumcircle $\Omega$. It is given that $OH\parallel BC$. Line $OH$ meets side $AB$ at $U$ and side $AC$ at $V$. Let $R$ be on $\Omega$ such that $\angle ARH=90^\circ$. Let the circumcircle of triangle $ROH$ meet $\Omega$ a second time at $S$. Show that lines $SO$ and $RH$ meet on the circumcircle of triangle $RUV$.
pumac-2025-finals-a-03.answer: Coordinates: with $M=(0,0)$, $O=(0,1)$, $H=(t,1)$, $A=(t,3)$ one finds $S=(-t,3)$ (so $AS\parallel BC$) and $SO\cap RH=(\tfrac t3,\tfrac13)$, which lies on $(RUV)$.
